title: SAD to screen Diljit Dosanjh's 'Satluj' across Punjab after Zee5 takedown to expose Congress 'repression'
description: SAD chief Badal said this is aimed at ensuring that today’s youth and our coming generations know about the unspeakable tragedy and repression unleashed by the then Congress governments against Jaswant Singh Khalra and thousands of other innocent Sikh youths.
